|strategy=By Tom Lischke<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/leiaseeker.html</ref>

Dark Side Rare 2 ([[A New Hope]])

[[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers can do a great deal to strengthen [[Death Star]] site defense. They actually work best in a deck that intends to use the [[Death Star]] Mobile System to do some planet busting. The [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers, combined with [[Death Star]] Gunners and Imperial Trooper Guards, can provide a pretty formidable first line of defense. With some luck, the [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers will come up in time to deploy them on the [[Death Star]] sites, and then deploy DS characters. This brand of seeker also has no effect on any of the DS spies, so the DS can also deploy [[Labria]], [[Garindan]], [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix){{!}}5D6-RA-7]], and [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio){{!}}U-3PO]] as a security force, along with some [[Nevar Yalnal]] in hand to prevent the LS spies from gaining a foothold.

[[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers can also be utilized as a formidable offensive weapon. Almost all Rebel characters are warriors of ability less than three, so they are all subject to the [[Leia Seeker]]. As the ruling presently stands, it is legal to transport seekers using [[Elis Helrot]], so no site is out of reach. A round of seeker transports can make a fine lead in to an attack. The DS can get rid of the high forfeit Rebel pilot/warriors with a few [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers, and then declare a battle and use the attrition to get rid of [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] or [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]].

Cards to watch out for: [[Remote]]

Combos:

[[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers + DS Spies + [[Nevar Yalnal]]. Total DS site defense. Of course, it doesn't hurt to include [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] and [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] in case the [[Death Star]]: [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]], Trash Compactor, or Level 6 sites are deployed by the LS.

[[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers + [[Elis Helrot]]. Hey, what's that humming noise?

[[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers + All three Docking Bays. With the DBs out, there is really no way for the LS player to escape from the Seeker, save [[Nabrun Leids]]. Just walk across the site line until the Seeker catches up. This brings new meaning to the term 'Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide.'

Hey, you can't do that Combo:

[[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] Seekers + [[Corellian Corvette]] or Millenium [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] + LS Unique Starfighters with pilots. When the LS brings the Rebel Navy to [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]] with some [[Corellian]] backup, use the ship docking capability to shuttle the Seekers onto the various starfighters.
